MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 14 February 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Petrolera del Orinoco S.A., a company incorporated under the laws of Venezuela ("Discloser"), and Alpha Technical Centre Ltd, a consulting company registered in England ("Recipient").

1. Purpose
The parties wish to evaluate a possible partnership on the Carabobo heavy oil area and will exchange technical and commercial information for that purpose only.

2. Definitions
"Confidential Information" means all data, reservoir models, well files, production histories and commercial terms disclosed by the Discloser, in any form.

3. Term
This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of three (3) years from the Effective Date, unless terminated earlier by written notice.

4. Confidentiality obligations
The Recipient's confidentiality obligations shall survive for five (5) years after the end of the disclosure period and apply to every copy of the Confidential Information.

5. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales, without regard to its conflict of laws rules.
